question: Should post-core plugin update and convergence evaluate plugin compatibility against the installed target package version before restart?
rationale: This is an upgrade-sensitive compatibility source-of-truth choice; the patch is coherent, but automation should not decide whether the installed target version is the permanent boundary for current-process post-core plugin checks.

options.title: Accept installed-target source of truth

options.body: Hold this PR until it also addresses the Linux/systemd unknown-host startup path or splits the issue closure scope explicitly.

options.title: Keep old current-process policy
